title: Nexus AddActorKnowledgeEntryRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/daemon/actor-knowledge/entries. Stored-owner admission only; clients never send owner_creator_id. `audience` is the only governance input: an omitted audience creates an in-scope shared entry. The legacy `creator_only` key is not a member of this schema and its presence is rejected (including `false`), never ignored.

summary.description: Optional authored summary for Character/binding owners; writes body.summary atomically. Rejected on World-owned create.

audience.description: Closed author audience for holder governance. Omitted means in-scope shared (no holder, no disclosure); explicit "shared" is the same. A private audience resolves against the admitted identity: the author never supplies a holder id or a management flag.

kind.description: In-scope shared knowledge: holder and disclosure stay unspecified.
Resolves to the admitted controlling Creator's own holder with disclosure owner-private.
Resolves to a Character this Creator owns; for a World-owned row that Character must be bound to that World.
